text: Centrifugal pumps in hydrocarbon (LDO), flammable, toxic or high-energy services (rated power above 150 kW or discharge pressure above 40 bar) shall comply with API 610 / ISO 13709. Pumps in water, utility and other non-hazardous services shall comply with ISO 5199 (or ISO 9908 for Class III up to 150 kW) or API 610 by package specification; vertical wet-pit circulating water pumps shall follow ANSI/HI 9.8 and the ER-08.03 requirements.
